crew.overview: Harold Crick is a lonely IRS agent whose mundane existence is transformed when he hears a mysterious voice narrating his life.
crew.title: Stranger Than Fiction

details.biography: Zach Helm (born January 21, 1975 in Santa Clara, California) is an American film director, producer, and screenwriter. He wrote the internationally-performed stage play Good Canary, wrote and directed the film Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium (2007), and has staged one-man performance pieces, most notably his revival of Spalding Gray's Interviewing the Audience.
details.name: Zach Helm
